slug: 2024-04-23 Tunisia - Biometric ID card and passport usage to begin in H1 2025

facts.fact: A ministerial session on 2024-04-22 decided to start using the biometric national identity card in H1 2025 following approval of Organic Law No. 22 of 2024 on the biometric identity card; the document gives no promulgation date and does not say the law is not yet in force.
facts.system: Organic Law No. 22 of 2024 on the biometric identity card
